notes.title: Dev update - Demo coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey all you fabulous friends! We have been busy little beavers as of late. Here’s a quick list of some of the features we’ve gently inserted into the game:
[list]
[*] New vaporwave environment
[*] New tutorial level
[*] New title screen
[*] New pause menu
[*] Dynamic maps with multiple levels that Seraph can pole-dance between!!
[/list]

Pretty soon we’ll launch a public playable demo along with a Discord channel to collect feedback from everyone. Stay tuned and keep dancin’!
